rounds.response: Nice question — here are a few low-pressure ways to start connecting: react to posts or drop a short “me too”/emoji, reply to someone’s comment with a specific nod or quick tip, or post a tiny intro like “Hi, I’m [name], on Week 2 — any tips for the quiz?” (you can copy-paste that). Asking one narrow question about a problem you’re stuck on often gets friendly replies faster than a broad “help me.” If you prefer, DM one person who seemed helpful and say thanks or ask one follow-up — no pressure. Anyone else want to share a quick icebreaker or welcome new folks?
